title: Google Halves Gemini 4's Price If It Can Use Your Prompts
description:
Gemini 4 Hydrogen is $1.50 in / $7.50 out per 1M tokens; the invite-only Contributor tier is $0.75 / $3.75, and Gemini 4 Argon goes from $2 to $1. In exchange, Google may use your prompts to improve its products. Source: aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing
